$comment: The organisation's Linear workflow: one per team, in order. type is Linear's state category. builtin marks a state Linear reserves: enabling triage creates it, and Linear refuses both to create it and to write to it, so the script only checks it is there and the description below is documentation only. scripts/create-workflow.sh creates the rest; SKILL.md explains them.

states.name: Triage
states.description: A request arrived in the user's words. Leaves with an owning persona, scope boundaries and size: design-ready small work to Todo, unclear intent to Spec, missing technical design to a documentation issue in Design.

states.name: Backlog
states.description: Accepted, not planned into a cycle.

states.name: Todo
states.description: One bounded deliverable is ready: implementation has reviewed design and settled contracts; documentation has clear design questions and artifact acceptance criteria.

states.name: Spec
states.description: Intent being pinned down: interview, refine, spec; a feature gets its phased PRD. Leaves when the user reviewed the PRD or the spec is on the issue.

states.name: Design
states.description: HLD, LLD, ADRs; contracts and the DB model. Leaves when the user reviewed the design and the contracts exist.

states.name: Planned
states.description: Reviewed design is decomposed into focused issues and dependencies. Leaves when actionable issues have native estimates, owned paths and cycle assignments with usable goals.

states.name: In Progress
states.description: Code and tests in the agent's own environment. Leaves when the PR is raised.

states.name: In Review
states.description: PR open; findings inline and as review issues; every thread resolved. Leaves when approved, or review made optional and CI green.

states.name: QA
states.description: Independent verification of a milestone's usable outcome, end to end and under concurrency. A failure is a bug issue.

states.name: Merged
states.description: In main, releasable, changelog line added; build and deploy pending. Leaves when deployed.

states.name: Blocked
states.description: Cannot continue; the status update carries the blocker block. Returns to the state it left.

states.name: Done
states.description: Deliverable verified: code deployed and exercised where specified (production by default); design-only artifacts committed and user-reviewed. A regression is a new bug.

states.name: Duplicate
states.description: Another issue tracks it; related as duplicate.
